newsitem.title: USA: Group asks Universal Hospital seek buyer.
newsitem.headline: Group asks Universal Hospital seek buyer.

text.p: A group led by Wynnefield Partners Small Cap Value L.P. Friday urged Universal Hospital Services Inc to consider selling itself to a "strategic buyer willing to pay the highest price" for the company.

The group, which disclosed it had acquired a 5.02 percent stake in the company in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing, said it saw merit in Universal Health's hiring of an adviser to examine ways to improve holder value.
But it raised concern over the company's decision to adopt an anti-takeover measure, saying the move was likely to discourage some of the best potential buyers.
